column2: The maximum number of concurrent SMS allowed.

column2: They restrict the trunk to handling only specific countries.

column1: What is the purpose of an MCC deny list on a trunk?
column2: To block specific countries for compliance or business reasons.

column1: When configuring Routes, how does priority numbering affect delivery selection?
